title: onSuccessUpdateEmail skips immutable-field validation
description: In handle_submission_set (submission.rs:446-473), patches from onSuccessUpdateEmail are applied to the Email via backend.update_object without calling find_immutable_patch_key. A client can set immutable Email fields (from, to, messageId, blobId, etc.) by including them in onSuccessUpdateEmail — same bypass as was just fixed for onSuccessUpdateOriginal in Email/copy. The fix: call email::find_immutable_patch_key (must be made pub(crate)) before update_object in the onSuccessUpdateEmail loop, and reject with invalidProperties if any immutable field is touched.
